content.title: CSK vs RR Highlights, IPL 2026: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi’s 15-ball fifty guides RR to an eight-wicket win over CSK
content.text: Vaibhav Suryavanshi starred on his Rajasthan Royals debut in IPL 2026, smashing 52 off 17 balls to power an eight-wicket win over Chennai Super Kings. The 15-year-old skipped birthday celebrations, opting for rest to stay fresh for the big clash.Vaibhav Suryavanshi continued his meteoric rise with a stunning display as Rajasthan Royals cruised to an eight-wicket win over Chennai Super Kings in their IPL 2026 opener. After RR bowlers restricted CSK to 127, the 15-year-old took charge, smashing a breathtaking 52 off just 17 balls, including five sixes and four boundaries.Suryavanshi brought up his fifty in only 15 deliveries — the third-fastest in IPL history — effectively sealing the chase early. His fearless, all-out attacking approach left the opposition with no answers, as Rajasthan chased down the target with ease to begin their campaign in dominant fashion.CSK vs RR Live Score: Did you know?47 balls remaining is the biggest win for RR and the second-heaviest defeat for CSK after 59 balls against KKR at Chepauk last year in terms of balls left in IPL.RR vs CSK Live Score: Rajasthan Royals enter in record booksLeast overs taken to complete a 120-plus chase in IPL9.4 - SRH vs LSG, Hyderabad, 2024 (Tar: 166)11.1 - KXIP vs KKR, Kolkata, 2018 (Tar: 125)12.0 - Deccan vs MI, DY Patil, 2008 (Tar: 155)12.1 - RR vs CSK, Guwahati, 2026 (Tar: 128)*RR vs CSK Live Score: CSK captain Ruturaj Gaikwad speaks after lossRuturaj Gaikwad reflects on CSK’s tough start in their IPL opener against Rajasthan Royals. The skipper admitted the conditions and a tricky wicket made batting challenging. “Even the spinners were getting some assistance. You just put it behind, move on. We have another game in three days,” said Gaikwad. He added that with many youngsters in the side, it’s hard to judge a par score and that the focus should remain on backing your game. CSK will look to improve their batting in the next outing.RR vs CSK Live Score: RR demolishes CSK with 8-wicket winRajasthan Royals made a resounding statement to start their season. New captain Riyan Parag won the toss and his bowlers delivered a collective masterclass, each chipping in with a wicket to restrict Chennai Super Kings to 127. The total always looked below par, but what followed made it seem even smaller.Vaibhav Sooryavanshi turned the chase into a solo fireworks display. Though dropped on the very first ball he faced, he made CSK pay immediately, dismantling the bowling attack and racing to a stunning 15-ball fifty. The Royals powered through the first six overs to post 74, effectively putting the game out of reach.Sooryavanshi eventually fell after reaching his milestone, but the damage was done. Yashasvi Jaiswal and Riyan Parag then eased the chase home, finishing the game with nearly eight overs to spare and a statement win for Rajasthan Royals.RR vs CSK Live Score: Rajasthan Royals chase down the targetYashasvi Jaiswal calmly nudged Matthew Short into the mid-wicket for 1 run, and Rajasthan Royals win by 8 wickets. The victory was sealed with style after an explosive opening from Jaiswal and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. Both teams shared handshakes and a few friendly words on the pitch, with Jaiswal showing composure to finish the match.Final Score: RR 128/2 in 12.1 oversRR vs CSK Live Score: Yashasvi Jaiswal brings RR to the brinkYashasvi Jaiswal smashed a towering six, taking RR right to the edge of victory, leaving just 1 run needed.He timed it beautifully off Matt Henry, while Riyan Parag rotated strike well and kept the chase calm. A wide review added a small moment of drama, but RR remain firmly in control.Score: RR 127/2 after 12 overs – 1 run to win.CSK vs RR Live Score: Riyan Parag finishes the over in style, RR almost thereRiyan Parag adds the finishing touch with a stunning reverse-sweep six off Noor Ahmad.Yashasvi Jaiswal continued to rotate strike, while Parag played the aggressor, ensuring RR stayed well ahead of the chase.Just a matter of time now as RR close in on a comfortable win.RR 115/2 after 11 oversRR vs CSK Live Score: Stat AttackJos Buttler (thrice), Yashasvi Jaiswal (twice), Vaibhav Suryavanshi (twice), Michael Lumb. Jaiswal joined in as well, finishing the over with a boundary.A perfect start for RR as they go hard in the chase.RR 18/0 after 1 overRR vs CSK Live Score: ‘Pink looks good on me’- Ravindra Jadeja shines on RR returnRavindra Jadeja enjoyed a memorable outing on his return to Rajasthan Royals, playing a key role with the ball and reflecting on a special night in new colours.“I think pink looks good on me,” Jadeja said with a smile, after making an immediate impact against his former team. The all-rounder revealed that familiarity helped him dismiss Shivam Dube, a batter he has bowled to extensively in the nets. “I knew he would look to play big shots, so I tried to bowl outside off,” he explained.Jadeja admitted the conditions worked in his favour. “The wicket was a bit sticky and the ball was turning. I really enjoyed bowling. My job was just to hit the right areas and let the pitch do the rest,” he said after his tidy spell.Despite CSK setting a modest target, Jadeja stressed the importance of focus in the chase. “You can’t take anything for granted in cricket. A cautious opening over with Archer asking the questions.CSK 7/0 after 1 overChennai Super Kings step into unfamiliar territory in IPL 2026. For the first time in the tournament’s history, they are playing a match without both MS Dhoni and Suresh Raina — two names that have defined the franchise for over a decade.For years, Dhoni and Raina were the backbone of CSK’s identity. Dhoni, the captain who built a legacy of calm leadership and success, and Raina, often called ‘Mr IPL’, were ever-present figures through the team’s highs and lows. Their absence marks not just a team change, but the symbolic end of an era.Dhoni has long been central to CSK as captain, finisher and wicketkeeper, but this match at the Baraspara Cricket Stadium will go ahead without him. His absence brings focus on the last time he missed a game and how often he has been unavailable since the IPL began in 2008.Chennai Super Kings face an early IPL 2026 challenge as MS Dhoni and Dewald Brevis are sidelined for their opening match against Rajasthan Royals. Brevis is out with a side strain, while Dhoni will miss the first two weeks due to a calf strain, impacting CSK's middle order and leadership.RR vs CSK Live Score: Riyan Parag Explains Bowling Call After RR Win TossRiyan Parag confirmed that conditions played a major role in his decision as Rajasthan Royals opted to bowl first against Chennai Super Kings.“There’s been a lot of rain, so there should be some moisture in the surface,” Parag said at the toss, explaining the thinking behind chasing. With overcast conditions around Guwahati, RR will look to make the most of any early movement on offer.Parag also spoke about stepping into the captaincy role, admitting it feels “nice” and highlighting the strong support he has received from within the setup. “Hopefully a good campaign for us. The goal is to win the championship,” he added.The Royals skipper emphasised the team’s approach in building the squad, pointing out that they have focused on bringing in “smart cricketers” to improve decision-making in key moments.With conditions expected to assist bowlers early, RR will aim for early breakthroughs, while CSK’s top order will need to navigate a potentially tricky start.CSK vs RR Live Score: RR Win Toss, Opt to Bowl First vs CSKRajasthan Royals have won the toss and elected to bowl first against Chennai Super Kings in the IPL 2026 opener in Guwahati.Captain Riyan Parag opted to chase, keeping the weather in mind with rain still a threat around the venue. The conditions, with some moisture around, could assist the RR pace attack early on.RR vs CSK Live Score: Rain update!There is a brief sense of relief in Guwahati as the rain has eased, offering a window of hope ahead of the IPL 2026 opener between Rajasthan Royals and Chennai Super Kings. However, the situation remains far from settled.While the showers have paused for now, the square is still under covers, and the ground staff are hard at work with the super-sopper, trying to get the surface match-ready. The conditions suggest that preparations are underway, but the outfield and pitch will need time before being deemed fit for play.The bigger concern remains the forecast. With more rain predicted later in the evening, there is still uncertainty around whether the match will proceed uninterrupted.CSK vs RR Live Score: CSK Begin IPL 2026 Amid Transition, Injuries and Fresh HopeChennai Super Kings find themselves at a crossroads as they begin their IPL 2026 campaign. The five-time champions have missed the playoffs in each of the last two seasons, prompting a rethink in approach and squad composition.Head coach Stephen Fleming admitted as much after the auction, suggesting the team may have been slow to adapt to the evolving demands of the format. The response was bold. CSK invested heavily in youth, signing uncapped players Prashant Veer and Kartik Sharma for a combined INR 14.2 crore, signalling a shift towards building for the future.However, their campaign begins with setbacks. MS Dhoni is expected to miss the first two weeks due to a calf injury, while Dewald Brevis has been ruled out of the opener with a side strain. Spencer Johnson, brought in as a replacement for Nathan Ellis, is also unavailable for now as he recovers from a back issue.In their absence, the spotlight shifts to Sanju Samson, who is set to open alongside captain Ruturaj Gaikwad. The team will also look to Shivam Dube for impact, especially after his confidence-boosting performances in the recent T20 World Cup.With the ball, Noor Ahmad and Khaleel Ahmed remain key pillars after consistent performances last season. Around them, a group of young and relatively untested players will look to seize their opportunity.For CSK, IPL 2026 is not just about results. It is about evolution.Rain clouds hang over the IPL 2026 opener in Guwahati, with forecasts raising concerns of possible interruptions in the clash between Rajasthan Royals and Chennai Super Kings.Both sides enter the new season looking to bounce back from disappointing 2025 campaigns, and they do so with fresh leadership and reshaped squads. Sanju Samson has moved to CSK, while Ravindra Jadeja returns to RR. Riyan Parag takes over as Royals captain, with Ruturaj Gaikwad leading CSK.While both teams aim for a reset, the biggest uncertainty ahead of the opener might just be the weather.CSK vs RR Live Score: Young Guns to Watch – Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Prashant VeerAmid the big names, IPL 2026 also brings fresh faces into focus. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi for RR and Prashant Veer for CSK are two players to watch.Sooryavanshi’s power-hitting stood out last season, with an impressive strike rate and ability to clear boundaries consistently. Opening alongside Yashasvi Jaiswal, he adds aggression at the top.Veer, on the other hand, is a promising all-round option. Known for his ability to bowl in the powerplay and hit big shots down the order, he offers flexibility to CSK.Both players represent the next generation and have a chance to make an early impact.In a game filled with established stars, these young talents could provide the surprise factor.CSK vs RR Highlights, IPL 2026: Rajasthan Royals and Chennai Super Kings enter IPL 2026 with a fresh look after finishing at the bottom in 2025. Rajasthan Royals have appointed Riyan Parag as captain, replacing Sanju Samson, who has moved to CSK. Ravindra Jadeja has swapped teams, leaving CSK to bring balance to RR’s squad, which struggled with two overseas spinners last season. RR now boasts a formidable pace attack with Jofra Archer, Nandre Burger, and Adam Milne, alongside the spin of Ravi Bishnoi and Jadeja’s control in the middle overs. The team will also need to choose between Donovan Ferreira and Dasun Shanaka in the all-rounder role, with Sam Curran ruled out for the season.CSK, meanwhile, have reinstated Ruturaj Gaikwad as captain, as MS Dhoni is expected to miss the first two weeks due to a calf injury. South Africa batter Dewald Brevis will also miss the opening game. CSK’s bowling has been hit by injuries, with Nathan Ellis out and Spencer Johnson recovering from his own fitness concerns. Matt Henry and Noor Ahmad remain key bowlers, while the team balances powerplay specialists like Khaleel Ahmed and Anshul Kamboj against middle-over options such as Akeal Hosein.The spotlight falls on Jadeja and Prashant Veer. Jadeja, returning to RR, offers both middle-over control and finishing power with the bat. Veer, a promising domestic talent for CSK, could step up in the powerplay and add finishing firepower down the order. Both teams will also navigate pitch conditions in Guwahati, where rain and a fresh pitch could influence strategies.RR and CSK will kick off their campaigns with challenging early fixtures, giving both teams an early chance to establish momentum and test their revamped line-ups before heading into the core phase of IPL 2026.
